payload.reason: Slice 1 satisfies the approved architectural boundary. All four authorized artifacts were created, no files outside the whitelist were modified, and the implementation correctly separates persistence-layer parity from the controller and service work reserved for Slice 2. The reported migration establishes both required R21 Major Project tables with the expected keys, constraints, and data structures. Both Eloquent models define explicit table mappings, fillable attributes, casts, and the required BatchSubject/Student relationships. Dedicated verification passes with 5 tests and 61 assertions, the full suite passes with 13 tests and 80 assertions, and all changed PHP files pass syntax validation. Existing M1.1 AuditLog coverage remains green, providing regression evidence. The explicit non-modification of routes, controller, AttainmentService, User.php, and frontend/print artifacts confirms scope discipline. No architectural blocker is reported. Slice 1 is therefore approved as complete from an implementation-review perspective. The next work should be the already-approved Slice 2: AttainmentService, R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController, route registration, and feature-level endpoint verification. A checkpoint commit should occur only after the orchestrator's verification/checkpoint protocol requirements are satisfied.

next_directive.objective: Implement Slice 2: port the R21 Major Project AttainmentService and backend controller, register the approved endpoints, and verify the backend contract with dedicated feature tests.
